# Email for notification type interview_completed (notifications.TypeInterviewCompleted): refactor plan step S10.
# Regenerate (a deliberate, release-noted behavior change only):
#   UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./internal/notify -count=1 -run '^TestNotificationContent$'
# Emailed by default (OPENV_EMAIL_NOTIFICATION_TYPES unset): no. The override run sets it to exactly the
# types the defaults leave out. Each message is the SMTP hand-off of the real mailer;
# every line ends CRLF on the wire (a bare LF would show as ␊, a bare CR as ␍).

======== chatter.created: an interview participant finished | delivery 1 of 2 | to user-ada
with the default allow-list: not sent; with the override: sent
envelope: smtp.example.test:587, MAIL FROM openv@example.test, RCPT TO ada@example.test, no auth
-------- message
From: openv@example.test
To: ada@example.test
Subject: Interview session finished
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8

Interview session finished

An interview participant completed their session.

Open it in OpenV:
https://openv.example.test/projects/proj-apollo/interviews

—
You are receiving this because email notifications are enabled for your OpenV account. Turn them off in Settings → Notifications.
-------- end
